missions.title: Benchmark Fixture Expansion
missions.goal: Design candidate benchmark fixtures that catch regressions in autonomy, typed-action validation, stale telemetry, replay protection, cooldown behavior, and false-success claims. Candidate artifacts only; do not alter the production Benchmark or run generated code.

missions.title: Knowledge Provenance
missions.goal: Design candidate provenance and HandoffEnvelope improvements for Kevin Knowledge. Preserve immutable raw-source hashes, claim/source links, evidence grade, assumptions, unknowns, staleness, semantic-success checks, and fail-closed behavior. Do not rewrite canonical memory or production knowledge automatically.

missions.title: Checkpoint and Resume
missions.goal: Design candidate checkpoint/resume mechanics for long-running Kevin missions. Persist stage, inputs, evidence, budget, retry family, next action, and semantic completion criteria so interrupted work can continue without duplicating side effects. Candidate artifacts only.

missions.title: Postmortem and Lesson Cleanup
missions.goal: Design candidate postmortem and reusable-lesson structures that distinguish symptom, root cause, fix, prevention, evidence, confidence, and review date. Prevent reflection from silently rewriting authority or canonical memory.

missions.title: Telemetry Quality
missions.goal: Design candidate telemetry improvements that distinguish activity from semantic progress, expose stale/contradictory states, preserve privacy, and make failed handoffs or saturated recovery visible without fake busy signals. Do not redesign the production Ops Floor avatar or visual system.

missions.title: Skill Evaluation
missions.goal: Design candidate skill-lifecycle evaluation fixtures covering trigger, inputs, tools, steps, validation, approvals, rollback, baseline-vs-with-skill measurement, retention criteria, and failure handling. Do not auto-install or auto-promote generated skills.
